name: PepsiCo, Inc.
summary: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal,
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 7/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 69/100 (Interessant), Innovations-Score 35/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 161.12 USD (+12 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
